warnings: The script repeatedly says 'today' and 'announced today'; that is consistent with the episode date, but a few lines make stronger immediacy claims than the sources strictly establish.
The Google school policy is about managed K-12 student accounts and school systems opting into AI; the script sometimes broadens this to all K-12 and university users.

The DeepMind post is a science/workflow demonstration with availability on Google Antigravity today, including an enterprise path and a limited free tier, so 'no public access' is too broad even though it is not a broad consumer product launch.
Several Meta lines use 'twenty-five billion' even though the supplied reporting supports fifteen billion; these are corrected as critical errors above.
The SAP transformation example is explicitly hypothetical and untested; the script is consistent on that point, but keep the distinction between a capability demo and a customer result.
